dialog.title: Embed FileOrbit
dialog.text:
Embed FileOrbit
Close

Local read-only preview: open the development host fixture. It embeds the viewer in a real sandboxed iframe with a synthetic snapshot.

Externally usable embed URL: not available. FileOrbit has no map hosting, publishing, stable embed URL, access policy, or sharing service in this build.

Snapshot boundary: local files, IndexedDB, handles, permissions, attachments, and private paths are not exposed. File opening is unavailable in the embedded viewer.

Open local iframe preview
Copy embed code — unavailable until hosting exists
